Record Class AIcgdInputProfile_1

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
eu.algites.tool.codegen.defs.AIcgdInputProfile_1
Record Components:
sourceKind - Selects the source-definition family handled by the frontend.
namingProfile - Names the naming profile applied while interpreting and generating identifiers.
requireCanonicalIdentity - Requires every loaded definition to expose a canonical identity.
requireDefinitionVersion - Requires every loaded definition to expose a semantic version.
public record AIcgdInputProfile_1(String sourceKind, String namingProfile, Boolean requireCanonicalIdentity, Boolean requireDefinitionVersion) extends Record
Defines how defs-codegen interprets one supported source-definition family.
